verdict: Kuih lapis wins slightly, an estimated ~130 kcal compared to seri muka at ~150 kcal. The difference is small, so pick the one you like most and watch how many pieces you take.
why: Kuih lapis is an estimated ~130 kcal per piece, seri muka ~150 kcal. The difference is only about 20 kcal.
Kuih lapis has 4 g fat, seri muka 5 g. Both contain santan (coconut milk), but seri muka has more in its top layer.
Protein is low for both (1-2 g), so neither keeps you full for long.
Small kuih make it easy to add 'one more'. Three pieces already come to an estimated 400-450 kcal.
when_a: Seri muka is okay for afternoon tea at the office or at home. Its glutinous rice is a bit more filling than kuih lapis.
when_b: Kuih lapis suits you when you just want a little something sweet, for example one piece with kopi O.
tip: Pick one piece and have it with an unsweetened drink. At events, take just one type of kuih, not a taste of everything.

faq.q: Can I eat kuih every day?
faq.a: It can fit if it's within your daily calories. Just make sure it's one piece, not one plate, and pair it with a plain drink.

faq.q: Kuih or biscuits, which is better?
faq.a: It depends on the size. One piece of kuih is about the same as a few biscuits. What matters is counting how many, not the type.
